zh: 這是本次真實 CLI 紀錄的字幕版；尚未配音。
en: Captioned recording of the real run. No narration has been generated.

zh: 先預檢再建立；setup 不會自動進入第一步。
en: Preflight, create, and verify. Setup does not start the research workflow.

zh: 建立了 11 個檔案；路徑由 config 解析。
en: Setup created 11 files. Canonical paths are resolved from config.

zh: 題目先保留「波動」的模糊處，讓流程真的追問。
en: The initial idea leaves volatility ambiguous so the skill must clarify it.

zh: TWSE 三個月份共 56 個交易日；資料取得不等於實證完成。
en: The three TWSE months contain 56 trading days. Data access is not analysis.

zh: 先決定構念；模型的建議仍要檢查，稍後收緊測量界限。
en: Define the construct first. We will tighten the proxy’s limits later.

zh: 選日內幅度代理，限制在描述性關聯；不做因果。
en: The demo researcher chooses an intraday-range proxy and a descriptive claim.

zh: 選擇與理由留在決策檔，不只停在對話。
en: The choice and its rationale are stored in the actual decision record.

zh: 第一步仍 partial；明確要求產生 conditional 設計草稿。
en: Step 1 remains partial. The researcher explicitly requests a conditional draft.

zh: 這是真實檔案；沒有把未完成的工作寫成 ready。
en: This is the actual Brief file. Unfinished work is not marked ready.

zh: 方法尚未執行；只能描述共同變動，不能做因果推論。
en: The methods are unexecuted. Co-movement does not establish causation.

zh: 選配和核心使用同一個 harness 與安裝位置。
en: The optional profile uses the same harness and target as the core.

zh: 核心仍是 42；finance-social-science 另新增 1。
en: The core stays at 42 skills; the optional profile adds one.

zh: 檢查描述性設計的效度，不硬加因果模型。
en: Audit the descriptive design without imposing a causal model.

zh: 判定 repair：公司行動、價量口徑與原始快照都還有缺口。
en: Verdict: repair. Corporate actions, scope alignment, and snapshots need work.

zh: 不報 p 值、不事後刪特殊日；仍不計算實證結果。
en: No p-values or post-hoc deletion of special days; no empirical results are computed.

zh: 補單位、口徑、推論邊界；v0.2 仍是 conditional，尚未重審。
en: Units, scope, and inference limits are revised. Version 0.2 remains conditional.

zh: 只完成資料取得與格式核對；原始資料的再發布授權仍未核對。
en: Only acquisition and format checks are complete. Redistribution rights remain unverified.

zh: 只回讀索引、claims 與必要狀態，不自動推進。
en: Read the index and claims; do not advance the workflow.

zh: 有審查檔，不代表已到第六步；取得資料不代表完成研究。
en: A review file does not mean Step 6 is complete; data acquisition is not study completion.

zh: 本片是研究設計實操；沒有因果、預測或投資結論。
en: This is a research-design walkthrough, with no causal, predictive, or investment conclusions.
